entities.summary: Anna Záborská was a Slovak politician of the Christian Union who was a member of the National Council from 2020 until her death in 2025. From 2004 to 2019 she was a Member of the European Parliament, where she was a member of the Group of the European People's Party (EPP).

entities.summary: Anna Záborská was a Slovak politician of the Christian Union who was a member of the National Council from 2020 until her death in 2025. From 2004 to 2019 she was a Member of the European Parliament, where she was a member of the Group of the European People's Party (EPP).
